selectionReason: studio-pro has the most genuinely-ready rc1Critical tasks (31) among the six products, with 0 of its ready tasks carrying an external gate, and its ready 'Project system contract' + 'Offline render contract' tasks map directly onto the mission's own Studio example (generated legal WAV/MIDI -> timeline edit -> save -> reopen -> offline WAV render).

recovery.priorityHit: #2 atomic save and recovery (continues Batch 1's Atomic Save primitive)

studioProVerticalSlice.pipelineStages: INPUT (procedurally-generated legal sine-wave WAV + a MIDI-like note list, no copyrighted/sourced content) -> VALIDATION (WAV/MIDI structural checks) -> PROCESSING (timeline clip placement/edit) -> SAVE (via Batch 1's real AtomicSave primitive) -> CLOSE (dispose in-memory session) -> REOPEN (load project JSON back from disk) -> OUTPUT (real offline, non-realtime WAV render: sample-accurate summation of timeline clips into one PCM buffer) -> FAILURE RECOVERY (corrupted project file detected and handled via this batch's own Recovery primitive) -> EVIDENCE.

prioritiesNotAttemptedThisBatch: #4 license verification foundation and #5 trial-state foundation: deferred to a future batch — cryptographic license verification deserves its own dedicated review rather than being squeezed in alongside 8 other tasks.
#6 no-autoplay contract: deferred — Global Stop (the paired primitive) already shipped in Batch 1; No-autoplay was not re-selected this round to keep the batch at 12 tasks total.
